_readme: English translations of the Google reviews in data/reviews.json, in the same order (the site says they are translated from Hebrew). name = the reviewer's name in English letters.

reviews.name: Linoy Sharon
reviews.text: I ordered a room for my backyard and didn't expect such great quality and service. The company answered every question I had in seconds, they're super nice and met all my requests. On top of that, the room arrived in just a week even though they commit to up to 21 business days, and they assembled it in an hour – it was ready. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Eldad Itah
reviews.text: The purchase started with Yitzhak, the sales rep – a warm, professional person who listens and really knows his stuff. It ended with an installation by Avi, who worked thoroughly, professionally and cleanly. Highly recommended!!!

reviews.name: Michael Grobman
reviews.text: Yitzhak was very patient with all my changes. A great person. Excellent service. A salesman without equal. The unit was delivered yesterday and Binyamin installed it perfectly. We're very happy.

reviews.name: Matan Gat
reviews.text: An excellent product – a shed that feels like a home – with excellent service and installation. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Roy Reuveny
reviews.text: A perfect, top-quality product with a top-quality team, in both service and installation. Thank you for everything!

reviews.name: Assaf Tene-Arama
reviews.text: A fantastic shed – works as an office, a study, a shed and even a living unit.

reviews.name: Dganit Luks
reviews.text: Excellent service. On time, and a product that feels like it will be with us for years. Thank you.

reviews.name: Shahar Bilis
reviews.text: Excellent service, very good quality, good insulation, and it's really nice to have windows all around.

reviews.name: Ayala Ayala
reviews.text: Very happy with the service, the finished product, the short delivery time, how functional the office/shed is, and the quick replies from dear Yitzhak and the rest of the dedicated team.

reviews.name: Ami Cohen
reviews.text: Really happy with the quality of the materials and the work. Simply perfect.

reviews.name: Liran Penso
reviews.text: Thank you so much for amazing service and a great attitude.

reviews.name: Alex Michal
reviews.text: A great product, fast service!!! Highly recommended.
